text:
Claire Nguyen: CascadeBridge asked for a 48h migration POC next week. Main asks: API parity with their current provider, websocket streaming semantics, key residency/KMS, and a modest migration credit.
Arjun Mehta: Do they use a particular streaming transport?
Claire Nguyen: They use persistent WebSocket connections (wss://api.vendor/stream) with per-frame JSON and expect empty-frame keepalives. They also rely on exact stop-token emission and a custom header X-Trace-Id.
Fiona Lo: We can emulate via our SSE + a tiny WS proxy that converts frames -> SSE and re-emits keepalives. Also copy X-Trace-Id into metadata for observability.
Ben Torres: Quick shim (node/ws):
```js
const WebSocket = require('ws');
const wss = new WebSocket.Server({port: 8080});
wss.on('connection', ws => {
  ws.on('message', async msg => {
    const req = JSON.parse(msg);
    const respStream = await redwood.stream({input: req.prompt, metadata:{trace:req.headers['x-trace-id']}});
    for await (const chunk of respStream) {
      // emit frames similar to their vendor
      ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'data', text: chunk.text}));
    }
    ws.send(JSON.stringify({type:'done'}));
  });
});
```
Fiona Lo: Also important: CascadeBridge batches multiple prompts per connection and depends on per-frame ids. We'll preserve `prompt_id` round-trip in the shim.
Arjun Mehta: Security: they require HSM import, SOC2 + FedRAMP low mention, and contract language around key residency. Legal also asked about subprocessors and BAA.
sec-bot: Auto-reply: "HSM import available on Dedicated/Private (lead time 5 business days). SOC2 report and FedRAMP low guidance available; BAA can be executed for healthcare customers. See internal: https://internal.redwood/compliance"
Ben Torres: Tokenization and stop-token behavior are the usual gotchas. CascadeBridge uses a custom stop-delimiter sequence ("<END>") appended by the client. We should add deterministic post-processing to ensure the sequence is emitted exactly once.
Fiona Lo: I'll add a normalization step: normalizeWhitespace + ensure stop-delimiter is appended only after final chunk and flushed immediately.
Arjun Mehta: Performance: they want p95 < 200ms for 256 tokens. Hosted currently averages ~170ms but p95 spikes during concurrent connections. Recommend a 48h Dedicated smoke window for the POC.
Claire Nguyen: Commercial: they asked for a short-term price match while migrating. Proposal from sales: 20% off hosted for first 30 days + a $12k migration credit if they sign a 12-month Dedicated LOI within 90 days. Also include a POC spend cap of $2k. Thoughts?
Ben Torres: Fine technically. Ops needs SRE window for Dedicated and we should include a canary fallback: if latency > 600ms route to a smaller replica with same API surface.
ops-bot: Note: Recommend smoke tests during Dedicated window:
- 250 concurrent websocket clients sending small prompts (<=32 tokens) measure p99
- 100 concurrent streaming sessions for 30s each
- parity harness run with their corpus (focus on HTML and stop-delimiters)
Fiona Lo: I'll run a 300-sample parity job focused on HTML, stop-delimiter, and per-frame ordering. Will upload diffs to the shared doc.
Arjun Mehta: Legal: I need DPA addendum + subprocessor list. Tagging Legal-Snitch to prep contracts.
Legal-Snitch: Looping in legal ops. We'll prepare a DPA addendum and draft BAA language. Note: liability cap update needs exec sign-off.
Claire Nguyen: Timeline: CascadeBridge wants results by next Friday (6 business days). Can we do this if approvals are quick?
Ben Torres: Tight but doable. Need SRE + billing approvals by EOD tomorrow to provision Dedicated pool.
Fiona Lo: Action items:
- Fiona: parity diffs + representative failing prompts by EOD (3600150000)
- Ben: repo for WS->SSE shim + deterministic stop-delimiter middleware
- Arjun: request DPA addendum and subprocessor list from legal ops
- Claire: draft commercial term sheet with POC cap and migration credit; loop finance
sec-bot: Reminder: For Private deployment, egress IPs are customer controlled. HSM import requires Dedicated/Private and lead time is 5 business days.
Claire Nguyen: I'll schedule a kickoff with CascadeBridge for tomorrow 11am PT. Please flag blockers here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
Fiona Lo: Noted one more nuance: they run a reranker step post-generation (cosine-sim embeddings + re-score). We should validate embedding parity too; I'll add a 200-sample embedding compare.
Ben Torres: Good catch. Add embedding unit mapping to the shim metadata so their reranker can correlate tokens->embeddings.
Claire Nguyen: Meeting created: CascadeBridge POC Kickoff - Tomorrow 2026-05-05 11:00 PT - https://cal.redwood/cascade-poc
Claire Nguyen: Final Q: objections to offering the proposed commercial bridge (20% + $12k) if finance ok?
Arjun Mehta: No technical objections.
Legal-Snitch: Legal ok to draft; need exec approval for liability cap change.
sec-bot: Security ok with HSM limited to Dedicated/Private and with documented key residency.
Ben Torres: Ops ok pending SRE window.
Claire Nguyen: Great. I'll post invite and attach parity doc when Fiona uploads it.
